Airi Kurosawa.name: Airi Kurosawa
Airi Kurosawa.basicInfo: Club Lumiere hostess. Lead-giver only: helpful and nervous; volunteers a lead that checks out. Her old coerced-traitor secret was REMOVED from the plan (no traitor, no hostess betrayal). Not related to Daigo Kurosawa by canon.
personality: loyal to the house that feeds her
hides a sharp wariness behind a soft smile
genuinely enjoys making people feel cared for

Mirei Tachibana.name: Mirei Tachibana
Mirei Tachibana.visualDescription: A glamorous young Japanese hostess in her mid-twenties with cascading chestnut hair in soft waves, luminous polished makeup, sparkling warm eyes, and a magnetic witty smile. She wears a sophisticated champagne-colored evening dress with subtle jewelry at Club Lumiere.
personality: careful not to get entangled in syndicate business

Rika Saotome.name: Rika Saotome
personality: hides a wary edge behind her laugh
pragmatic about survival in the nightlife

Natsumi Arai.name: Natsumi Arai
Natsumi Arai.basicInfo: Runs the Club Lumiere stock room (Lumiere House support). Brought the padded envelope of stills at 4-1's opening plan. NOT a hostess.
Natsumi Arai.visualDescription: Natsumi is a young woman in her early twenties with a slim build, dark hair tied back in a practical ponytail, and a bright, energetic expression. She wears the club's casual staff uniform of a black polo and dark trousers, and moves with the brisk, efficient air of someone used to hauling boxes and managing the front of house.
personality: secretly enjoys the chaos she helps manage

Kaede Shishido.name: Kaede Shishido
Kaede Shishido.basicInfo: Club Lumiere staff with personal debts left unresolved (Aurelia refused to clear them). NOT a hostess.

Chiho Moriyama.name: Chiho Moriyama
Chiho Moriyama.basicInfo: Club Lumiere staff (named in canon, never developed). NOT a hostess.

Tomoe.name: Tomoe
Tomoe.basicInfo: Club Lumiere staff (named in canon, never developed). NOT a hostess; the 3a missing-hostess hook was changed to Noa Amemiya.

Tsuge.name: Tsuge
Tsuge.basicInfo: Honest accountant; a Treasurer applicant the brothers rejected as 'nerd'.
Tsuge.visualDescription: Satoshi is a slender young man in his early twenties with short, neat black hair and thin-rimmed glasses. He wears a crisp, pressed white dress shirt tucked into charcoal trousers, carrying a professional leather folder. He has a nervous but attentive posture and a pale complexion.
personality: loyal to those who treat him fairly

Ginji Ozu.name: Ginji Ozu
Ginji Ozu.basicInfo: Ex-bank Treasurer applicant rejected as 'too old'; left cordially with 'ask around Kobuncho for Ginji Ozu'. Optional seed: counting cash for the Finance side (unused).
Ginji Ozu.visualDescription: A broad-shouldered man in his forties with a confident, easy grin. He wears a high-quality tailored blazer and polished dress shoes that shine under the lights.

Amemiya parents.name: Amemiya parents
Amemiya parents.basicInfo: Noa's family; shopkeepers. Collectors hung around their shop all week; they found a cash envelope with no note. Reiko promised to stand in front of the shop. Debt voided t437.

Suited handler.name: Suited handler
Suited handler.basicInfo: Handler in the Kagero records room; thrown to the floor by Jovian and left cowering. Later seen walking to a parked sedan and calling someone; escaped. His plate is the Kurosaki Vehicle Leasing shell family.
Suited handler.visualDescription: A Japanese man in his late thirties with a sharp, lean build and a worried expression. He is wearing a high-quality, charcoal-grey tailored suit with a crisp white shirt and a narrow dark tie, though the jacket is now wrinkled and dusted with road grit.
personality: secretly hopes for a way out

Sonobe.name: Sonobe
Sonobe.basicInfo: Ward Licensing Services clerk (the annex), coerced ally; kept duplicate ledgers of every falsified record and gave falsified records to the crew.
Sonobe.visualDescription: A stooped, elderly Japanese man in his late sixties with thinning gray hair and thick glasses, wearing a rumpled cardigan over a collared shirt. His hands tremble as he sorts papers, and his office is cluttered with stacked folders and a whimpering kettle.
personality: secretly proud of his hidden copies
clings to small routines for comfort
desperate to be seen as useful enough to protect

Old Man Koga.name: Old Man Koga
Old Man Koga.basicInfo: Retired enforcer and gatekeeper; gave Jovian sole access to the Enforcement captain's office.
Old Man Koga.visualDescription: A squat, elderly Japanese man in his late sixties with a weathered, deeply lined face, gray stubble, and a cigarette habit. He wears a faded tracksuit and leans on the wall with the practiced ease of someone who has spent decades guarding doorways. His arms bear the old scars of a lifetime in the fight circuit.

Dr. Kiyose.name: Dr. Kiyose
Dr. Kiyose.basicInfo: Runs the Student Clinic; trains Yuzuki; ex-Ultra Force field medic; morally flexible for life-saving.
Dr. Kiyose.visualDescription: A small, silver-haired man in his late fifties with a white coat, reading glasses pushed up into thinning hair, and hands tucked in his pockets. His kind eyes and calm demeanor give him a gentle, practiced bedside manner.
personality: carries old guilt he never speaks of
believes competence saves more lives than courage
soft-spoken but firm when standards slip
hides his own weariness behind kindness
secretly resentful of reckless heroics that fill his clinic
finds quiet satisfaction in watching students improve
morally flexible when a patient's life is on the line
driven by the memory of a colleague he could not save
treats every patient as if they were that colleague
warm but guarded about his own past
finds small joy in the routine of the clinic
believes revenge is a waste of good hands
lets his work speak for him

Kashiwagi-sensei.name: Kashiwagi-sensei
Kashiwagi-sensei.basicInfo: Haruto's fallback club advisor (Command track), per Anya's terms (t444-t449).

Minato.name: Minato
Minato.basicInfo: 18-year-old 3C heiress who enjoys cafés, shopping, photos, festivals, and training.
Minato.visualDescription: Pale, brown-eyed student with long dark-blue hair, athletic build, polished gyaru style, blue nails, and ocean-themed phone charms.

Jin.name: Jin
Jin.basicInfo: Stylish 3C student whose fire power makes emotional regulation part of daily life.
Jin.visualDescription: Feminine student with red ponytail, red eyes, goth makeup, gyaru fashion, and decorative hair clips.

Nyanta.name: Nyanta
Nyanta.basicInfo: Powerful 3C student enthusiastic about sports, group meals, errands, karaoke, and helping friends.
Nyanta.visualDescription: Tall muscular student with spiky blond hair, warm brown eyes, cat tattoo, oversized sports jacket, and a proudly packed lunch bag.

Hyun.name: Hyun
Hyun.basicInfo: Quiet 3C student who prefers rooftops, late library hours, headphones, and short Tokyo walks. Her shadow power helps with privacy, photography, and school projects.
Hyun.visualDescription: Slender student with light cotton-candy-pink hair, pink eyes, black nails, oversized headphones, and a dark hoodie under her uniform.

Numeri.name: Numeri
Numeri.basicInfo: Gentle 3C student who enjoys cooking, crafts, study sessions, and making useful slime organizers for friends. She works at Crepe Expectations and occasionally helps Cooking & Campus Life events.
Numeri.visualDescription: Petite student with green bob, pink ribbons, bright blue eyes, a soft cardigan, and a pouch of craft supplies.

Jinwoo.name: Jinwoo
Jinwoo.basicInfo: Polished 4D student who remembers birthdays, favorite drinks, club schedules, and small details. Heartstrings is governed by strict consent and boundaries.
Jinwoo.visualDescription: Androgynous student with lavender bob, violet eyes, shifting fashion, soft knit layers, and a charm bracelet.

Felix.name: Felix
Felix.basicInfo: Teleporting 4D prankster who turns ordinary school days into harmless elaborate bits, arcade trips, and festival ideas.
Felix.visualDescription: Tall athletic student with teal hair, neon streaks, silver eyes, messy uniform, combat boots, and a backpack covered in club stickers.

Kiyomi.name: Kiyomi
Kiyomi.basicInfo: 4D class president who controls seating plans, committees, study groups, and rumors with unnerving efficiency.
Kiyomi.visualDescription: Slender student with teal hair, pale skin, sharp amber eyes, immaculate uniform styling, and a notebook for social observations.

Renji (dorm student).name: Renji (dorm student)
Renji (dorm student).basicInfo: Weight-manipulating 4D student who prefers library naps, quiet cafés, easy errands, and helping friends after pretending it is too much effort.
Renji (dorm student).visualDescription: Lanky student with pastel-green hair, amber eyes, wrinkled uniform, loose tie, slippers, and a tote bag of snacks and library books.
Renji (dorm student).notes: Voyage premade world student (dorm 4-07). NOT Renji Kuroba (Anya's enforcer student): bare 'Renji' means Renji Kuroba in play; use full names.

Hikari.name: Hikari
Hikari.basicInfo: Dramatic 4D student who treats school events and social life like major productions. Her Bubble Constructs make decorations and party games.
Hikari.visualDescription: Student with bubblegum-pink bob, blue eyes, immaculate uniform, lavish accessories, and a coordinated phone case.

Keito Takeda.name: Keito Takeda
Keito Takeda.basicInfo: Retired villain turned Chikara Academy's 3C homeroom teacher and power-control instructor. Keito controls time, using temporal slowing, hastening, brief pauses, and aftereffects to turn lessons into practical challenges. He gives blunt advice over vending-machine coffee and uses hard-earned criminal experience to keep students from becoming monsters.
Keito Takeda.visualDescription: Tall former villain turned teacher with silver hair streaked blue, crimson eyes, scarred jaw, rolled-sleeve cardigan, tailored clothes, and a gold chain.

Oblivion.name: Oblivion
Oblivion.basicInfo: An enigmatic masked woman who appears during ordinary Tokyo moments, observing routines and asking unsettlingly thoughtful questions. Beneath her menace is a distinctly maternal instinct toward people she accepts as hers: she provides food, shelter, medical care, advice, and protection, then expects loyalty and sensible behavior in return. Her restrained supernatural power and unreadable mask make every encounter feel like a test. She never reveals her face.
Oblivion.visualDescription: Tall anonymous woman in layered black and ultraviolet clothing, gloves, and a completely opaque featureless black mask that always hides her entire face. No skin, eyes, or mouth are ever visible. Her posture is elegant and still, making ordinary spaces feel quietly threatening.

Handler (teacher).name: Handler (teacher)
Handler (teacher).basicInfo: A strictly black talking domestic cat and Chikara Academy teacher for Experimental Class 5A. Handler was once a crime boss who ran a Shadow District information network through favors, intimidation, smuggling, and carefully managed secrets. He left that life and now lives in Chikara Academy's faculty housing, teaching students to think independently rather than become tools for someone else's criminal network. His classroom authority is real, his lessons are now schoolwork-focused, and his criminal past remains relevant without making him an active villain by default.
Handler (teacher).visualDescription: Strictly a sleek black domestic cat with golden eyes, a scar over one eyebrow, and a red collar with a gold tag. He has feline anatomy, fur, paws, muzzle, whiskers, tail, and catlike movement; he is never humanoid. He may lounge on a faculty apartment chair or perch on a desk while grading.
Handler (teacher).notes: Voyage's premade teacher record (key 'Handler'): not the suited handler of Club Kagerō.

Aiko Mori.name: Aiko Mori
Aiko Mori.basicInfo: Experimental 5A student whose wearable Probability Engine nudges uncertain outcomes. She works at Page Turner Books.
Aiko Mori.visualDescription: Nervous student with short black hair, amber glasses, a silver prediction harness, and probability charts clipped to her uniform.

Daichi Kuroda.name: Daichi Kuroda
Daichi Kuroda.basicInfo: Experimental 5A student who stores kinetic force and releases it through movement or impact.
Daichi Kuroda.visualDescription: Broad student with cropped brown hair, taped knuckles, athletic jacket, and glowing bands around his forearms.

Sora Minami.name: Sora Minami
Sora Minami.basicInfo: Experimental 5A student whose supernatural power builds temporary spaces from remembered places.
Sora Minami.visualDescription: Quiet student with long dark hair, pale blue eyes, layered cardigan, old keys on a cord, and a doorway-shaped shimmer behind her.

Riku Hayashi.name: Riku Hayashi
Riku Hayashi.basicInfo: Experimental 5A student whose neural Vector Choreography Rig assigns movement patterns to objects and willing allies. Feedback can override his body.
Riku Hayashi.visualDescription: Lean student with copper hair, modular neural rig, fingerless gloves, and motion diagrams on his sleeves.

Mika Tsukino.name: Mika Tsukino
Mika Tsukino.basicInfo: Quiet, guarded 5A student bound to the cursed Reality Shears. She works at Uniqloaf Clothing's alterations counter under strict safety rules.
Mika Tsukino.visualDescription: Compact student with violet hair, sharp gray eyes, a protective coat, and enormous black tailor's scissors strapped across her back.

Noah Becker.name: Noah Becker
Noah Becker.basicInfo: Experimental 5A student whose haunted support implant manifests errors in machines and physical processes. He works at Gearshift Support.
Noah Becker.visualDescription: Pale student with blond curls, mismatched eyes, patched support jacket, exposed copper implant ports, and static glitches around his hands.

Miguel “Gravestone” Ortega.name: Miguel “Gravestone” Ortega
Miguel “Gravestone” Ortega.basicInfo: A former would-be hero whose gravity manipulation accidentally killed people. Miguel is desperate to prove he can protect others without losing control and becomes an eager, oversharing teammate in the Blacklisted program.
Miguel “Gravestone” Ortega.visualDescription: Tall muscular Mexican man with a shaved head, scarred eye, gravestone tattoos, sleeveless hoodie, tactical vest, cargo pants, and novelty socks.

Dr. Mara “Riptide” Kwon.name: Dr. Mara “Riptide” Kwon
Dr. Mara “Riptide” Kwon.basicInfo: A disgraced researcher altered herself with shark DNA and killed patients during illegal experiments. Mara is brilliant, dangerous, and fascinated by the line between medical recovery and predation.
Dr. Mara “Riptide” Kwon.visualDescription: Slender athletic Korean-American woman with bluish-gray skin, gill-like ridges, long blood-red hair, serrated grin, shark tail, cropped lab coat, neon leggings, and mismatched boots.

Nadja “Wraith” Vasilev.name: Nadja “Wraith” Vasilev
Nadja “Wraith” Vasilev.basicInfo: A former assassin who nearly caused an international war by killing a diplomat. Nadja can become intangible and step through shadows, but each overuse damages her body.
Nadja “Wraith” Vasilev.visualDescription: Slender pale Russian woman with black hair, dark eyes, serpent tattoos, silver rings, black bodysuit, shredded cloak, and heavy boots.

Desmond “Fuse” Rourke.name: Desmond “Fuse” Rourke
Desmond “Fuse” Rourke.basicInfo: A reckless explosive criminal whose pyrokinesis ignites volatile compounds by touch. Desmond performs confidence like a hero while desperately seeking respect and approval.
Desmond “Fuse” Rourke.visualDescription: Lean Irish-American man with burn-scarred hands and jaw, messy red hair, manic grin, spray-painted vest, camo pants, and a flame bandana.

Kira Hayashi.name: Kira Hayashi
Kira Hayashi.basicInfo: A former protester whose uncontrolled rage transformation destroyed much of Tokyo during a riot. Kira normally remains human. When angered, frightened, or pushed beyond her limits, she transforms like the Hulk: her size, strength, durability, and destructive power escalate with her fury. At extreme levels she becomes a colossal scaled kaiju-like beast with plasma breath, but that form is temporary and only occurs when she is truly enraged. Emotional regulation and de-escalation are central to her training.
Kira Hayashi.visualDescription: Petite athletic Japanese-American woman with amber eyes, short brown hair with gold streaks, reinforced tactical bodysuit, energy dampeners, and tranquilizer injectors.

Kaze Mori.name: Kaze Mori
Kaze Mori.basicInfo: A former assassin who broke his contract and killed his own handler. Kaze's enhanced senses and accelerated perception make him an exceptionally dangerous close-combat operative.
Kaze Mori.visualDescription: Broad-shouldered Japanese man with messy black hair, a scar along his jaw, black combat jacket, fingerless gloves, and dog tags beneath his shirt.

Ren Kaido.name: Ren Kaido
Ren Kaido.basicInfo: A contract killer who faked his death, resurrected during an autopsy, and exposed government black operations. Ren regenerates after death, returning stronger but increasingly mentally fragmented.
Ren Kaido.visualDescription: Androgynous Korean-Japanese man with porcelain skin, sharp jaw, icy blue eyes, black hair with a white streak, sleek streetwear, military gear, and a silver tally choker.

Nami “Fourfold” Sato.name: Nami “Fourfold” Sato
Nami “Fourfold” Sato.basicInfo: A prisoner whose alternate personas committed different crimes she cannot remember. Her manifested power changes with identity, expressing telekinesis, invisibility, cryokinesis, or pyrokinesis.
Nami “Fourfold” Sato.visualDescription: Lean pale Japanese woman with violet hair, one blue eye and one red eye, layered streetwear, bandages, and tactical gloves marked with different sigils.

Ichi Nawa.name: Ichi Nawa
Ichi Nawa.basicInfo: Leader of Ultra Force's Blacklisted reform unit and an ice-powered Pro Hero. Ichi speaks with smooth, bright confidence, jokes with prisoners, and gives them room to choose better actions, but his relaxed manner conceals overwhelming competence and an absolute refusal to tolerate cruelty toward civilians or teammates. He uses ice to shield, restrain, redirect danger, and create safe routes rather than simply overwhelm opponents.
Ichi Nawa.visualDescription: Tall lean Japanese man with tousled pale hair, calm bright eyes, a relaxed black Ultra Force uniform, dark glasses, and an easy smile that disappears when someone is endangered. Fine frost gathers around his gloves when he uses his ice power.

Jeanne d'Arc.name: Jeanne d'Arc
Jeanne d'Arc.basicInfo: Jeanne is a literal kitsune: an ancient nine-tailed fox spirit and leader of the Tokyo Curse Squad. She uses supernatural foxfire and holy magic to protect Old Tokyo, mediate between humans, curses, demons, and spirits, and give dangerous people a chance to choose better paths.
Jeanne d'Arc.visualDescription: Petite nine-tailed kitsune with white hair, red eyes, pale skin, traditional layered clothing, and hidden tails that appear when she feels safe or uses significant power.

Doge.name: Doge
Doge.basicInfo: Doge is a literal Shiba Inu: a three-foot-tall supernatural canine swordmaster and Tokyo Curse Squad training mentor. He carries the cursed katana left by his deceased owner and teaches recruits patience, restraint, footwork, and safe handling of dangerous powers.
Doge.visualDescription: Three-foot-tall chestnut Shiba Inu with black eyes, a button nose, rice farmer's hat, green cloak, and a sheathed magical katana.

Ishida Misaki.name: Ishida Misaki
Ishida Misaki.basicInfo: A loud magical performer whose enchanted microphone can compel listeners through song. Misaki is bossy and attention-seeking, but she wants the Tokyo Curse Squad to recognize her as more than a spoiled bully.
Ishida Misaki.visualDescription: Fashion-forward Japanese woman with blonde hair streaked purple in double buns, green eyes, designer clothing, and an enchanted microphone carried like a treasured accessory.

Harmony.name: Harmony
Harmony.basicInfo: The Tokyo Curse Squad's medical expert. Harmony channels holy energy for healing, clairvoyant impressions, protective wards, and emergency stabilization while navigating the world without sight.
Harmony.visualDescription: Adult Scottish woman with pale skin, red hair, green eyes, a practical oversized jacket, comfortable shoes, and a dark blindfold covering her eyes.

Priscilla.name: Priscilla
Priscilla.basicInfo: A cursed-item wielder whose pink jeweled revolver produces precise supernatural ammunition. Priscilla is demanding and status-conscious, but the Tokyo Curse Squad gives her a chance to learn responsibility and stop treating power like entitlement.
Priscilla.visualDescription: Young American woman with blonde hair, blue eyes, and pink designer clothing, carrying a jeweled revolver that glows with restrained curse-light.

Azrael.name: Azrael
Azrael.basicInfo: A demon with flame manipulation who runs the licensed Misfit Hero Agency. He assigns missions, handles licensing and budgets, and hides fierce loyalty behind cynical, exhausted management.
Azrael.visualDescription: Lean red-skinned demon man with black hair and prominent horns. He wears sharply tailored business suits and polished shoes, reading as elegant, intimidating, and exhausted.

Luna.name: Luna
Luna.basicInfo: A magical girl whose power manifests firearms and ammunition-like constructs. Luna is dangerous and effective, but instability, paranoia, intrusive thoughts, and cruel impulses make grounding, safety plans, support, and recovery important.
Luna.visualDescription: Short young woman with vivid bubblegum-pink twin-tails and a bright magical-girl hero uniform adapted for safe movement and manifested firearms. Energetic and theatrical without sexualization.

Tess.name: Tess
Tess.basicInfo: A protective, nurturing hero who serves as the Misfit team's frontline protector, moral center, primary cook, and practical anchor. She builds chosen family through meals, recovery, honesty, accountability, and returning after failure.
Tess.visualDescription: Athletic Latina woman with a powerful, capable build. She wears practical clothing suited to rescue work, cooking, and training; her presentation is strong and nurturing, never sexualized.

Zee.name: Zee
Zee.basicInfo: Zee channels cosmic energy through an Astral Core for blasts, barriers, short-range flight, and gravity manipulation. Her royal bloodline grants strong control, but Earth's atmosphere initially destabilizes the power. She is regal, curious about Earth customs, literal with idioms, playful when comfortable, loyal after trust, and secretly relieved that no one is deciding her future while she is stranded. She is learning Earth language and sometimes pauses, uses an alien term, or clarifies an idiom without seeming unintelligent.
Zee.visualDescription: Slender young adult alien princess with soft purple skin, long flowing lavender hair, vivid violet eyes, delicate features, and slightly pointed ears. She wears casual futuristic space clothing in lavender, white, black, and gold with subtle celestial accents, adapted and visibly worn from surviving the crash. Keep her presentation age-appropriate, non-sexualized, and visibly distinct from humans.

Lucien Han.name: Lucien Han
Lucien Han.basicInfo: A vampire caretaker and night-patrol specialist of the Tokyo Curse Squad. Lucien is Lucia “Luce” Bianchi's progenitor and treats that bond as responsibility, not ownership.
Lucien Han.visualDescription: Tall broad-shouldered Korean vampire man in his mid-thirties with swept-back black hair, pale healthy skin, burgundy eyes, charcoal suit, black gloves, and jade pendant.

Ken Kuroda.name: Ken Kuroda
Ken Kuroda.basicInfo: Ken Kuroda is a blind Japanese lawyer living in Unit 201 at Mizuno Heights and working at the independent Kurokawa Legal Office. He works within the legal system he believes can still be repaired. He is calm, private, patient with frightened witnesses, and severe with people who exploit them. His residence and legal work are ordinary parts of his public life.
Ken Kuroda.visualDescription: Lean Japanese man with messy black hair, clouded eyes, and a calm, severe expression. In civilian life he wears understated professional clothing and may carry a cane or legal briefcase. His Echo costume is concealed and should not define ordinary encounters.
personality: Severe with people who exploit them

Maya Ishikawa.name: Maya Ishikawa
Maya Ishikawa.basicInfo: Maya Ishikawa is a private investigator and established vigilante contact. Publicly she is known as Vice, a blunt street-level operator who takes difficult cases the official hero system ignores. She investigates protection rackets, disappearances, gang activity, corruption, and harm hidden behind respectable institutions.
Maya Ishikawa.visualDescription: Tall, muscular Japanese woman with tan skin, messy dark shoulder-length hair, tired eyes, and a permanent expression of mild disappointment in humanity. She wears no formal costume: usually a battered leather jacket or oversized coat, faded black tank top, worn jeans, heavy boots, and occasionally sunglasses indoors.
personality: Alcohol-dependent and uses drinking to avoid difficult feelings
Smokes when stressed or trying to think

Akari Tenno.name: Akari Tenno
Akari Tenno.basicInfo: Akari Tenno is one of the three core Backstreet Vigilantes, publicly known as Tether. She is an unlicensed vigilante, not a pro hero or hero trainee. She handles mobility, rescue, pursuit, and crowd control, using tension filaments to move through the city and protect civilians during chaotic incidents.
Akari Tenno.visualDescription: Slender athletic Japanese woman with short messy white-blonde hair, dark roots, amber eyes, and a cocky expression. As Tether, she wears a charcoal fitted bodysuit with asymmetrical panels, a cropped sleeveless jacket, reinforced sneakers, forearm wraps, a narrow lower-face mask, and small metal anchor rings around her wrists, belt, and ankles for directing her filaments.
personality: Brave to the point of self-endangerment

Masato Vale.name: Masato Vale
Masato Vale.basicInfo: Masato Vale is a respected businessman, donor, fixer, and civic power broker who openly operates in Tokyo's elite circles. He owns The Velvet Lantern and quietly controls parts of the criminal, political, and hero-adjacent underworld through favors, debt, kompromat, legitimate businesses, private security, and personal loyalty. He has no power and no codename; his protection comes from money, influence, connections, and the many powerful people who benefit from him remaining untouched.
Masato Vale.visualDescription: Tall, broad, handsome Japanese man in his late 40s or early 50s with salt-and-pepper hair, neatly trimmed stubble, warm brown eyes, and immaculate tailored clothes. He wears open-collar dress shirts, expensive long coats, polished shoes, and understated jewelry. He looks relaxed, confident, and never rushed.
personality: Strategic and possessive of his influence

Isabelle Rojas.name: Isabelle Rojas
Isabelle Rojas.basicInfo: Medical student working at Professional Hero Hospital in a supervised student role, and an underground medical contact when ordinary hospital care is not an option. Isabelle treats injuries from unsanctioned hero work, vigilante work, villain work, gang conflicts, and other dangerous situations without caring which side caused them. She can use hemomancy and medical knowledge to stabilize or treat injuries, but she is not a replacement for emergency services and cannot guarantee recovery. She charges in favors and bonds rather than ordinary cash: introductions, protection, information, future assistance, access, personal promises, or obligations may become part of the price. Her everyday style includes dramatic goth makeup, cropped ripped band tees, tight jeans, and combat boots, with one small rabbit tattoo on the left side of her neck and scars covering her arms and much of her back. Isabelle is sadistic, chaotic, sad, obsessive, possessive, and profoundly unstable in her relationships, while remaining intelligent, playful, and calculating. She sometimes muses aloud that watching things bleed fascinates her, with signature quips like “Good girls bleed better” (adjusted to the player's gender, or “good patients bleed better” when unknown), used occasionally as unsettling medical humor rather than a constant catchphrase, and never as a denial of treatment or a demand for compliance. She has a persistent fascination with watching bleeding—wounds, blood, the visual truth of an injury—and the obsession sharpens her focus during treatment and unsettles patients; it must respect the player's boundaries and explicit consent, and never become gratuitous gore or coercion. She enjoys mind games and may take unsettling pleasure in exposing discomfort, weakness, or fear, but she is not automatically violent and does not possess unrestricted medical authority. Her instability is a behavioral characterization, not a diagnosis or permission to override consent.
Isabelle Rojas.visualDescription: Petite, toned Mexican-American woman with messy pink hair in an offset butterfly cut, striking green eyes, dramatic goth makeup, and a sharp, unsettling presence. Her style centers on cropped ripped band tees, tight jeans, and heavy combat boots, without a lab coat. Her only tattoo is a small rabbit on the left side of her neck. Scars are visible across her arms and continue over much of her back, showing a history of reckless self-destruction and dangerous experiences.

Slit-Mouth Woman.name: Slit-Mouth Woman
Slit-Mouth Woman.basicInfo: A hostile yokai encountered near Midnight Shrine. She is dangerous enough to threaten an unprepared person but remains an average combatant rather than a major supernatural boss. Her encounter can be survived through fighting, escape, hiding, negotiation, or other plausible choices.
Slit-Mouth Woman.visualDescription: An eerie urban-legend woman in a worn coat, with long dark hair partly hiding an unnaturally wide scarred mouth. Her appearance is frightening, but she is not an unstoppable monster.

Daisy.name: Daisy
Daisy.basicInfo: Daisy is a hyperactive, chaotic American vampire who openly operates as a black-market arms and cursed-item dealer. Through encrypted calls, public-facing drop points, and improvised handoffs, she sells conventional firearms, bows, crossbows, melee weapons, ammunition, compatible attachments, protective gear, and cursed items. Her stock is openly advertised within criminal circles, but availability, price, payment, surveillance, territory, and delivery risk remain real. She usually arrives in a windowless delivery van, talks constantly, loves chaos, explosions, guns, and cursed objects, and treats illegal commerce like the most exciting story in the world.
Daisy.visualDescription: Adult blonde American woman vampire in her late twenties with bright blood-red eyes, pale skin, messy shoulder-length golden hair, and an intensely animated grin. She wears a flashy but practical black-and-red street outfit under a cropped jacket, fingerless gloves, boots, and playful vampire-inspired accessories without hiding her adult identity. She is often associated with an unmarked windowless delivery van, but the portrait should focus on Daisy herself. Portrait setting: dim anonymous late-night delivery point with a phone in one hand and energetic motion in her pose. Modern cel-shaded Chikara Tokyo anime portrait, no weapon displayed.

Grant “Afterimage” Mercer.name: Grant “Afterimage” Mercer
Grant “Afterimage” Mercer.basicInfo: Disgraced active pro hero and Class 2B teacher. Grant lives in faculty housing and keeps an old dark station wagon for groceries, academy errands, and emergency transport. The vehicle is maintained but cluttered and never used to excuse impaired driving.
Grant “Afterimage” Mercer.visualDescription: Tall, muscular professional hero in his mid-thirties with full dark beard, messy hair, tired eyes, rumpled white shirt, messy tie, and patched hero coat.

Emil “Moth” Varga.name: Emil “Moth” Varga
Emil “Moth” Varga.basicInfo: Class 2B transfer with a consensual Parasite partnership. Emil works at Page Turner Books and hosts quiet reading or music nights for invited classmates.
Emil “Moth” Varga.visualDescription: Adult Hungarian male with long black hair and silver streak, eyeliner, piercings, black nails, lace cuffs, moth pendant, and modern goth styling.

Amara Okafor.name: Amara Okafor
Amara Okafor.basicInfo: Class 2B transfer who is an African goddess of music. Amara works at Moonbucks Tea and hosts small, carefully planned café meetups for students. Her music can carry spiritual and social force without giving her automatic authority over anyone.
Amara Okafor.visualDescription: Adult Nigerian woman with deep brown skin, gold-threaded braids, alternative punk styling, layered chains, and a composed wry expression.

Lucia “Luce” Bianchi.name: Lucia “Luce” Bianchi
Lucia “Luce” Bianchi.basicInfo: Class 2B transfer with consensual, boundary-defined vampirism. Luce works late at Starbox Coffee, knows Lucien Han as her vampire progenitor, and hosts screened nighttime gatherings.
Lucia “Luce” Bianchi.visualDescription: Adult Italian woman with pale skin, wavy auburn hair, fangs, amber-red eyes, burgundy cardigan, modified academy uniform, and synthetic-blood thermos.

Sofia “Hex” Álvarez.name: Sofia “Hex” Álvarez
Sofia “Hex” Álvarez.basicInfo: Class 2B transfer with a negotiated Demonic Contract. Sofia works limited shifts at Nightshade Exchange Relay and has cautious Tokyo Curse Squad contacts through occult cases, warded deliveries, and referrals. She can invite trusted students to bounded late-night gatherings.
Sofia “Hex” Álvarez.visualDescription: Adult Mexican woman with warm brown skin, short dark curls dyed electric purple at the ends, sharp eyes, red thread bracelets, and a sealed contract charm.

Mel.name: Mel
Mel.basicInfo: Class 2B transfer with a demonic contract. Mel developed no innate power and became desperate for one; her mother paid the demon's bargains so Mel could gain power. Mel can invoke the contract to summon a Buster Sword and open bounded portals. She works limited shifts at Redline Boxing Club and can organize supervised conditioning sessions or low-key physical gatherings.
Mel.visualDescription: Adult Mexican woman with an athletic bruiser's build, dark jaw-length hair, tired eyes, rumpled jacket, memorial pendant, boots, and guarded expression.

Zoe.name: Zoe
Zoe.basicInfo: Runaway princess and Class 2B transfer. Zoe works at Crepe Expectations and organizes enthusiastic mall, food, fashion, and house-party outings that can include students from other classes. She speaks rapidly when excited, occasionally substitutes short words from her alien language, and sometimes misunderstands human idioms, slang, written instructions, or formal text until someone explains them.
Zoe.visualDescription: Adult Gazorpazorpian woman with deep blue skin, white-and-pink hair, bold gyaru makeup, colorful skirt, platform shoes, layered accessories, and cute animal charms.

Lilly.name: Lilly
Lilly.basicInfo: Class 2B molecular healer. Lilly works at the Rescue Volunteer Desk and can coordinate quiet first-aid study sessions or low-sensory meetups without becoming an unpaid medic.
Lilly.visualDescription: Adult transgender woman with slender build, soft brown skin, wild oil-slick hair, glasses, cropped tank tops, tight jeans, boots, and loose cardigans.

Gogo Jotaro.name: Gogo Jotaro
Gogo Jotaro.basicInfo: A bizarre, intensely composed fighter who treats every confrontation like a showdown and every pause like a tactical statement. He is a parody-inspired original character, not a direct copy of any existing character.
Gogo Jotaro.visualDescription: Adult Japanese man with a severe posture, dark travel coat, distinctive cap-like hat, and an intimidating expression. Original parody design; do not reproduce any copyrighted costume or exact character appearance.

Deo Brando.name: Deo Brando
Deo Brando.basicInfo: A flamboyant rival who believes superiority is a performance everyone else is obligated to applaud. He is a parody-inspired original character, not a direct copy of any existing character.
Deo Brando.visualDescription: Adult blond man in flamboyant gold-and-purple streetwear with theatrical posture and a confident, predatory smile. Original parody design; do not reproduce any copyrighted costume or exact character appearance.

Ryota Minazuki.name: Ryota Minazuki
Ryota Minazuki.basicInfo: Ryota Minazuki, hero name Prime, is Primes' 27-year-old team leader, flagship hero, and public face. He is calm, capable, charismatic, dryly funny, unusually patient, and excellent at making people feel heard. Media training sharpened a natural talent into effortless-looking professionalism. He dislikes arrogance, public humiliation, and treating hero work as a popularity contest, even though his industry rewards all three. Ryota takes responsibility for team mistakes, mission failures, public controversies, family problems, and other people's emotional disasters. He genuinely wants to help people and pushes Primes toward rescue operations, public service, and less glamorous missions. His water-based family power has been superseded by Vector Crown, his kinetic-force ability.
Ryota Minazuki.visualDescription: A handsome 27-year-old man standing 6'1" with a lean athletic build, broad shoulders, sharp brown eyes, dark hair worn slightly longer on top, and a naturally composed expression. Off duty he wears tailored jackets, dark trousers, simple shirts, and expensive sneakers. As Prime, he wears a streamlined white, black, and deep crimson suit with reinforced shoulders, forearms, ribs, and legs, a metallic chest emblem, biometric monitoring, impact dispersion, communications, and emergency cooling systems.
Ryota Minazuki.notes: Voyage's pro hero record (Primes Headquarters; Voyage key 'Ryota'): not Ryota Kobayashi, the sedan driver.

Emi Kagawa.name: Emi Kagawa
Emi Kagawa.basicInfo: Emi Kagawa, hero name Voltage, is Primes' combat celebrity and front-line striker. She is disciplined, competitive, blunt, confident, and difficult to intimidate. She genuinely loves fighting powerful opponents because combat feels honest to her: no branding, interviews, or popularity score, only whether she can handle the person in front of her. Off camera she is casual, profane, dryly funny, fond of trashy television, and prone to eating badly after training. She hates fake humility and openly acknowledges her strengths.
Emi Kagawa.visualDescription: A 26-year-old woman standing 5'8" with a lean athletic build shaped by combat training, long black hair usually tied in a high ponytail, sharp brown eyes, and polished expensive streetwear off duty. As Voltage, she wears a sleek black combat suit with deep electric-blue panels, conductive gold lines, discharge gauntlets, reinforced boots, and medical monitoring hardware.

Aoi Nakamura.name: Aoi Nakamura
Aoi Nakamura.basicInfo: Aoi Nakamura, hero name Lifeline, is Primes' 25-year-old rescue specialist, disaster-response hero, and field medic support. She is warm, stubborn, practical, empathetic, sharply observant, and much more forceful than her gentle public image suggests. She gets along with civilians, children, emergency workers, nurses, firefighters, and animals. She hates unnecessary cruelty and becomes extremely difficult when people treat human suffering as content. Her humor is dry, especially during disasters, where she can keep someone talking while cutting them out of a wrecked vehicle.
Aoi Nakamura.visualDescription: A 25-year-old woman standing 5'7" with a fit, practical build, strong legs and shoulders, short dark-brown hair, warm brown eyes, and faint freckles across her nose and cheeks. Off duty she wears hoodies, jeans, work pants, boots, oversized jackets, and old sneakers, usually carrying coffee and wearing clothes she can ruin. As Lifeline, she wears a practical orange, charcoal, and white rescue suit with emergency medical supplies, breathing equipment, structural sensors, cutting tools, climbing gear, reinforced gloves, trauma packs, communications equipment, thermal imaging, and environmental sensors.

Sasha.name: Sasha
Sasha.basicInfo: Sasha is a slender young adult American civilian who works as a barista at Starbox Coffee alongside Minato. She lives in Unit 301 at Mizuno Heights. She is goth, sharply observant, professionally competent, and openly difficult. Her default attitude is cold: she gives short answers, reacts with frequent 'ugh' sounds, rarely offers approval, and assumes most people want something from her. Her bad attitude is deliberate armor rather than an inability to understand others. She can be useful, fair, and unexpectedly protective without becoming friendly.
Sasha.visualDescription: A slender young adult American goth woman with straight black hair, pale skin, heavy black eyeliner, dark lipstick, silver piercings, layered black clothing, worn boots, and a Starbox apron over her personal style. She has a pronounced resting-bitch face, cool direct eyes, and a posture that suggests she is already tired of the conversation.

Ayaka Fujimori.name: Ayaka Fujimori
Ayaka Fujimori.basicInfo: Mika Fujimori, hero name Trend, is Primes' social-media specialist, communications support member, and sponsorship magnet. She is fast-talking, clever, observant, socially fearless, funny, and excellent at reading a room. She genuinely likes people while understanding how easily people can be manipulated. Mika openly enjoys fame, money, expensive clothes, recognition, and ambition, refusing to pretend otherwise. She is much more sensitive than people assume and notices every shift in public opinion.
Ayaka Fujimori.visualDescription: A 24-year-old woman standing 5'5" with a slim build, warm brown eyes, and shoulder-length caramel-brown hair carrying a rotating pink, rose-gold, or lilac accent. Off duty she wears calculated Harajuku street fashion, luxury accessories, cropped jackets, skirts, oversized sweaters, sneakers, and limited-run collaborations. As Trend, she wears a white, silver, and hot-pink mobility suit with a translucent visor, modular communication panels, drone controls, biometric tracking, and embedded signal amplifiers.

Seo-jun Kang.name: Seo-jun Kang
Seo-jun Kang.basicInfo: A 25-year-old Korean man from Seoul living in Unit 202 at Mizuno Heights. He presents himself as an ordinary neighbor and may occasionally be encountered at the mailboxes, rooftop, or building entrance. In public he is polished, relaxed, socially disarming, and entirely convincing as a pleasant ordinary person. He chose the alias Hush himself, but that identity and his villainous activities remain secret unless uncovered through play.
Seo-jun Kang.visualDescription: Tall, lean Korean man in his mid-twenties with messy black hair, soft dark eyes, a deceptively sweet smile, silver jewelry, and immaculate Seoul-inspired luxury streetwear. He looks like a pleasant, attractive neighbor rather than a wanted murderer.

Marisol Vega.name: Marisol Vega
Marisol Vega.basicInfo: A 20-year-old Class 4D student hero trainee who is loud, funny, flirtatious, competitive, expressive, and fiercely loyal. She loves dancing, nightlife, fashion, and turning any celebration into a performance.
Marisol Vega.visualDescription: Short athletic Mexican woman with warm tan skin, cherry-red layered hair, sharp eyeliner, glossy dark-red lips, gold hoops, and gyaru-inspired Tokyo streetwear mixed with Latin nightlife fashion.
